## `neuro.uint8Array.toBase64`

Instance method on `Uint8Array.prototype`.

> Converts the `Uint8Array` to a base64-encoded string.

## Signatures

```ts
toBase64(input: { uint8Array: <receiver>; options?: { alphabet?: "base64" | "base64url" | undefined; omitPadding?: boolean | undefined; }; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.prototype.toBase64` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
